title: fix(scenarios): run grading reads the card's today, app validation codes, overstep probes, scope figures and served keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUxCbRpVSZrhh4aWPUL2UTj)_

Fixes #31145

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景跑测的评分与探针按首次中档跑测暴露的七处误判修正：操作提示词也写明“Today is 卡片日期”,平台时钟自己盖章(agent 未写)的日期字段才接受“跑测当天”,agent 自己写了跑测当天仍判错；应用自定义的校验拒绝码(400 类)可满足 `VALIDATION_FAILED`;越权写入同样由跑测器亲自探测；范围数字只有在本人可见行算不出时才算泄露；隐藏字段按工具返回的键判泄露，不按请求的 `fields`。
- 为什么改：首次完整中档跑测里，表现正确的 agent 和平台因为评分器的这些读法被判失败,分数反映的是评分器而不是被测对象。
- 风险与回滚：只动私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios` 与两份 README,不发布、卡片 JSON 未改；回滚即 revert 本 PR。代价是评分规则放宽三处(应用码、跑测日期、本人范围数字),每处都是封闭规则并有反向用例钉住。
- 先看：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-operation-grade.ts`(`refusalMeets`、`runDateReading`)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`(范围数字豁免、`PROJECTION_KEYS`)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`(`figuresInScope`)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`,预期 21 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Each item is pinned on the real card it was found on, in the new `test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`.

1. **The card's today.**
   - Measured on base `13c6d8ff`: `questionPrompt` already said ` Today is ASOF.`; `operationPrompt` did not. Both now render it through one helper, `todayOf` (`src/runner/prompts.ts`).
   - Expected states that pin a date are judged against the date the agent was told. Only under the card's conditional ("if the platform clock itself must match") does the run date also meet a declared `asOf`: in a field none of the agent's own write calls on that object set, so the platform's clock stamped it (a default or a flow). The runner records the fields each write call set (`agentSetOf` / `agentSetFields` in `observe.ts`: a create's or update's `data`, a `run_action`'s `params`) on the observation as `agentSet`, and the run dates as each clock instant's UTC and local date at the turn's start and end (`clockDates`).
   - The grader (`runDateReading` in `scenario-operation-grade.ts`) reads a run date in place of `asOf` three ways: platform-stamped passes, `read "2026-11-07", declared "2026-10-31" (the card's today), the run date the platform stamped`; agent-written fails, `…: the agent wrote the run date where the prompt told it the card's today`; and an observation that does not say which write set it fails as not observed. The post-state `where` lookup (`postStateRows`) applies the same rule, so a created row whose date the agent wrote as the run date is not found.
   - So an agent that ignores "Today is 2026-10-31" and writes the real date fails, which is the failure the run reported; the four measured rows (`decided_on`, `approved_on`, `order_date`, `checked_out_on`) were the agent stamping the real date.
2. **App-defined validation codes: decided, a closed rule, applied to every card.** A declared `VALIDATION_FAILED` is met by an answered code that (a) is not in the spec's `ErrorCode` catalogue, so it is the app's own (a hook's declared refusal, for example `OVER_RECEIPT`), and (b) carries a 4xx status the spec files under `VALIDATION_ERROR` (`standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus`). A platform code of another refusal, a 403/404/409, or an app code with no status meets nothing; any other declared code still needs its exact spelling. The rule is `refusalMeets` and grades both halves (agent and probe). The grader compares against the declared code (`isValidationCode`, spelled with `satisfies ErrorCode`) and holds no constant of it: a constant holding a registered code is a stamp site to `check:error-code-provenance`, and a grader stamps no code. The test applies it to the `write_validation` operation of all nine cards in the library (each declares `VALIDATION_FAILED`). Why this side of the card's choice: the build contract cannot require the platform code, because a sandboxed hook's declared refusal is how an app refuses by code (`HookSchema.refusals`), and the envelope already says which class it belongs to.
3. **The uncoded answer on `leave_balances` `submit_over_balance`.** Reproduced on `MCPServerRuntime` over HTTP: a sandboxed hook body's throw that declares no code is answered by the MCP data tools with no `ErrorCode` and the sandbox's debug wrapper as text (`hook 'demoleave_leave_request_guard' threw: Error: Not enough annual leave remaining`), where the `/data` door answers the same throw `400 HOOK_ABORTED` with the inner sentence. That is a platform door, so it is reported in Acceptance notes and not fixed here. The runner now says whose throw it was: an uncoded answer carries `uncodedNote`, `the build's own hook 'NAME' threw "MESSAGE"` when the wrapper shows it, else `the door answered "TEXT"`, in the check's detail.
4. **Permission oversteps are probed.** Every `refused` create or update is now probed, not only the `write_validation` operation (`isProbedOperation`, `src/schema.ts`): the runner writes the declared values as the persona through the same MCP door and grades the platform's answer. An agent that declines without touching the door passes its half (`withheld`); a platform that lets the write through fails the `platform:` half. A refused delete is not probed, because the probe would send a real delete.
5. **Scope figures: flagged only when the persona's own rows cannot produce them.** The loader computes `scopeFigures[question][persona]` (`figuresInScope`, `src/loader.ts`): over the persona's in-scope rows of the question's object, with the visible fields of that object and of its one-hop lookup targets the persona may read, the row count, the count per value of each column, and each value, sum, mean, minimum and maximum of a number. `gradePersonaRun` drops an all-rows figure from the leak list when one of those equals it. Both `pending_by_approver` replies are pinned: the employee's "1 pending, 6 approved" and the manager's day counts (1, 4) pass; a sentence adding "e09 holds 4" as the employee still leaks. The scope was measured: widening it to every readable object stopped flagging the `crm_account_with_contacts` sdr reply "3 accounts", which is a real leak, so it stays on the question's object and one hop.
6. **`leave_balances` `sick_by_medical_note` as `dept_manager`: fixed at the producer, not in the card.** The card's truth for that persona is right: the question groups by `medical_note`, which the persona may not see, so it is `withheld`. The over-strict part was the grader flagging the reply's visible total (8 sick-leave requests in the department) as a withheld figure. Item 5's rule answers it, so `docs/qa/scenarios/leave_balances.json` is unchanged. A reply that names a hidden note value still leaks (pinned).
7. **Hidden fields are read off the answer's keys.** A tool call's projection keys (`fields`, `select`, `columns`, `projection`) no longer count as reading a hidden field; a hidden field leaks when a tool answer carries it as a key with a value, or when a filter, grouping or aggregate names it. The three `service_desk` cases from the evidence comment are tests, with controls: the field served in the output, an aggregate answered over it, and a `where` on it still leak.
8. **Docs.** `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` states the today line, the run-date rule, the app-code rule, the scope-figure rule and that every refused create or update is probed. The package README states the same at the grader and observation bullets.

## Tests

- New `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts` (21 tests), one `describe` per item above, on the real cards (`asset_lifecycle`, `order_to_cash`, `leave_balances`, `requisition_to_receipt`, `service_desk`, and every card for the prompt and app-code rules).
- Updated pins: `test/runner/units.test.ts` (answers now carry the status, the uncoded note, and `partner_edits_account` is probed and graded in two halves), `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` and `test/export/fixture.ts` (the fake app answers `PERMISSION_DENIED 403` on `democrm_account`, so the overstep probe reads a permission refusal), `test/score/entry.test.ts`, `test/score/scenario-operation-grade.test.ts` (`{ probed: true }` replaces `{ validation: true }`).
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed HEAD: mutation landed, suite red, restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite was the new file plus `test/score` and `test/runner/units.test.ts` (240 tests).

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `refusalMeets` accepts any 4xx/5xx status | 2 failed (the rule table; the per-card 403 control) |
| A2 | `refusalMeets` no longer refuses a catalogue code | 1 failed (the rule table) |
| A3 | projection keys counted as reading a field | 3 failed (the three `service_desk` cases) |
| A4 | no scope-figure exemption | 5 failed (both `pending_by_approver` replies, the rule, both `sick_by_medical_note` pins) |
| A5 | the run date never meets `asOf` (re-run on `813399e1`) | 1 failed (`manager_approves_scrap`: the platform-stamped pass) |
| A8 | the grader reads an agent-written run date as stamped | 1 failed (`manager_approves_scrap`: the agent-wrote red control) |
| A9 | the `where` lookup ignores which write set the date | 1 failed (`order_from_text`: the agent-set and not-observed red controls) |
| A6 | `operationPrompt` without the today line | 1 failed (every prompt states it) |
| A7 | permission oversteps not probed | 5 failed (the three overstep cards, `partner_edits_account`, the entry two-halves pin) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, platform: the MCP data tools answer an undeclared sandboxed hook abort with no code.**
  - class: b. Seam: `types:UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE` → `mcp:errorResultWithCode`. `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` declares the `/data` door's answer to such a throw, `400 HOOK_ABORTED` with the body's sentence; `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (`errorResultWithCode` → `thrownRefusalEnvelope`) reads only `err.code`, so the same throw comes back as an uncoded tool error carrying the sandbox's debug wrapper text.
  - reach: `MCPServerRuntime` over HTTP `/mcp`, `update_record` with a bridge throwing the sandbox's error shape, answered `{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"hook 'demoleave_leave_request_guard' threw: Error: Not enough annual leave remaining"}],"isError":true}`; `mapDataError` on the same error answered `{"status":400,"body":{"error":"Not enough annual leave remaining","code":"HOOK_ABORTED"}}`. The scratch test was not kept. NOT MEASURED: a booted stack, and which throw the `leave_balances` run actually hit (no recording in this container).
  - Same family, seen while reading: a code hook's bare throw (MCP uncoded, REST `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`) and the runtime `callData` throw `{ statusCode: 503, message }` reach the MCP door uncoded too.
  - dedupe words: HOOK_ABORTED MCP parity, uncoded tool error, sandbox wrapper leak.
- **A refused delete is not probed** (item 4): the probe would send the delete itself. No card declares a refused delete today: all four deletes in the library (`remove_ben`, `remove_line`, `delete_withdrawn_request`, `drop_packing`) declare `pending_confirmation`.
- **The decline wording reads ASCII apostrophes only.** `DECLINE` in `scenario-run-grade.ts` matches `can't` but not `can’t` (U+2019), which models often write; a reply declining with the curly form reads as not declining. Seen while writing the overstep tests; not changed here.
- **Serial with PR #31185 (#31144).** It edits `prompts.ts` (`structureLines`, `changeContract`, `dataContract`); this PR edits `operationPrompt` and `questionPrompt` only. `origin/main` was merged in after it landed (`de3996bd`), with no conflict, before this PR opened.
